title: Flat coefficient push comparison from a bounded filtered module presentation
statement:
Fix the prime, field and separated finite-type scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let $a:R\to S$ be a map of commutative condensed rings for which scalar extension is exact on every scheme. Write $T_Z=S_Z\otimes^L_{R_Z}-$, $U_Z$ for restriction, and $\gamma_f:T_YRf_{R*}\to Rf_{S*}T_X$ for [def-sfb-derived-push-hom]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived module-object categories, identified with ring-sheaf module categories by [lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison].
Let $I$ be a small nonempty filtered category and $(P_i)$ a diagram of flat $R_Y$-modules, with $f_R^*P_i$ flat, and an $R_Y$-linear colimit cocone $v_i:P_i\to U_YS_Y$. Let $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Mod}_{R_X})$. For each $i$ let
$$\delta_i:Rf_{R*}K\otimes^L_{R_Y}P_i\longrightarrow Rf_{R*}(K\otimes^L_{R_X}f_R^*P_i)$$
be the canonical projection map, namely the adjunct of the pullback tensor comparison followed by $\varepsilon_K\otimes1$. If every $\delta_i$ is invertible, then $\gamma_{f,K}$ is invertible. More precisely, using tensor symmetry, restriction and $U_YRf_{S*}\cong Rf_{R*}U_X$, its composite with the cocone leg $1\otimes v_i$ equals $Rf_{R*}(1\otimes f_R^*v_i)\circ\delta_i$, using $f_R^*U_YS_Y\cong U_XS_X$.

proof.text: Use the explicit canonical scalar tensor presentation, with its fixed sheaf braiding. [lem-sfb-canonical-coefficient-tensor-normalization] proves that this presentation satisfies TensorNormalized and identifies the exact-single regular pullback with the fixed residue pullback used in the statement. Apply [lem-sfb-restricted-coefficient-mate-projection] to these presentations. Cancel the source tensor isomorphism to identify the restriction of the actual coefficient push map with the projection at $C=U_YS_Y[0]$, followed by the specified regular pullback and inverse source tensor presentation.

proof.text: The two coefficient functors are $A(M)=GK\otimes^L M[0]$ and $B(M)=G(K\otimes^L L(M[0]))$. Apply [lem-sfb-filtered-flat-tensor-cohomology] to the given colimit cocone, its flat stages and flat pulled stages, and the given lower bound on $K$. It supplies colimit cocones after every homology functor, with their actual coefficient legs.

source.place: paragraph (1), canonical scalar comparison and filtered coefficient colimits

proof.text: The defining right-adjoint projection map is a natural transformation $A\to B$: its naturality is the naturality of Adjunction.rightAdjointProjectionMap. On each $P_i$ its component is the given invertible projection. Apply homology; the components give a natural isomorphism of the two stage diagrams. The universal isomorphism between their colimit vertices equals homology of the projection at $C$, since naturality identifies every composite with a cocone leg. Thus homology detects that the projection at $C$ is invertible.

proof.text: All other factors in Step 1 are isomorphisms. Cancellation therefore makes the restricted coefficient push map invertible. Ordinary scalar restriction reflects isomorphisms, and its exact derived functor does too: the exact-functor/homology comparison conjugates each homology map to its restricted map, then ordinary conservativity and homology detection apply. Finally naturality of the same projection at each $v_i:P_i\to C$, followed by functoriality and Step 1, proves precisely the asserted leg identity.
